title: Spring
review: An early Benson and Moorhead movie without them appearing in it. For most of it I thought it was my favourite of their films, and maybe that's because they don't initially doesn't bite off more than they can chew with detailed concepts, or maybe I just gravitate more towards this kind of thing. {Before Sunrise} could have ended up like this... {Only Lovers Left Alive} does this better. The leading man is maybe a bit plain, but the film does start with him in an emotionally numb state. I started to like the characters more as time went on, but unfortunately I had some big reservations with the third act...
spoilers: The classic story of a manic pixie dream girl, where love is blinding him from all the diseases and baggage she has. Except in this case it's like she has every fantasy curse imaginable. She's a vampire werewolf siren witch with Las Plagas and The Flood from {Halo}. At least that's what you're lead to believe, until a baffling scene full of exposition about her lifecycle, that put me off the film little bit. It's not quite as romantic when it gets all Midi-chlorians in the third act. It feels so clunky as it pivots fast, and everything that happens next relies on you buying into these new contrivances.
